fusions.name: Swing Aboard
fusions.desc: You swing up to 7 tiles onto the target and bring both fists down for 14 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Belaying Pin Fling
fusions.desc: Throws a belaying pin for 7 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: Moves you 2 tiles from where you stood and increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Topman's Grip

riders.text: you go up the shrouds faster than over ground
and you swing clear of what is thrown at you
and one hand is always free to hit with

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 4% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold you attack 6% faster.
